speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuralgia of the Auriculotemporal Nerve (part of Trigeminal Nerve involvement) secondary to post-tympanoplasty scar tissue entrapment. The "shooting" pain triggered by chewing (jaw movement) and the discomfort with earrings (pinna movement) localize to the auriculotemporal nerve branch of V3, which is commonly irritated by surgical scarring or graft issues in the tympanic sulcus or external auditory canal. The MRI and CT scan will confirm if there is any residual mass or cholesteatoma contributing to this nerve irritation, but the clinical presentation strongly suggests nerve entrapment.
